overlapMethod: GEOS positive-area polygon intersections in EPSG:4326, against unchanged Vicmap 2022 state boundaries and current property-aligned LGA polygons retrieved 2026-10-02. Touch-only edges are excluded; small positive-area boundary slivers remain included. Links express spatial intersection, not a one-to-one jurisdiction or a population/finance share. No centroid assignment, simplification or allocation. Source topology defects are repaired with GEOS make_valid only in the analysis copy for label placement/intersections. Display/download source geometry is unchanged. Defects are listed in analysisTopologyRepairs. Council-region intersections are derived through the verified exact union of each region’s 11 Assembly district geometries (zero symmetric difference in the state geometry QA), avoiding redundant overlay computation.
